name: Paulingerhof
beschreibung: The Paulingerhof is located in a rural setting in Tirol and is typical of the region as an inn. The location is suitable for guests who want to actively experience nature, such as hiking or skiing. The rooms are simply and practically furnished. The atmosphere in the house is family-like and traditional. The restaurant offers regional dishes based on the cuisine of Tirol. The overall furnishings contribute to an uncomplicated stay. The inn is aimed at travelers who value unpretentious accommodation.
